parameters.pythonCode:
# One Semaphore task alert (its Slack JSON, the webhook's body) as a ticket event: host,
# service, state, text. A task that ended in ERROR opens its template's ticket; its next
# SUCCESS closes it; anything else (WAITING_CONFIRMATION, an alert naming no template) is
# nothing. Rules as zammad-bridge's semaphore_to_checkmk (QUEUE-n8n-zammad.md).
import re

STATES = {"ERROR": "CRITICAL", "SUCCESS": "OK"}

body = (_items[0]["json"].get("body") if _items else None) or {}
attachments = body.get("attachments") if isinstance(body, dict) else None
first = attachments[0] if isinstance(attachments, list) and attachments and isinstance(attachments[0], dict) else {}
name = re.sub(r"^Task:\s*", "", str(first.get("title") or "")).strip()
text = str(first.get("text") or "").strip()
status = re.search(r"status:.*?\b([A-Z][A-Z_]+)\b", text)
state = STATES.get(status.group(1)) if status else None
if not name or not state:
    print("nothing to ticket: " + repr(str(first.get("title"))[:80]) + " " + repr(text[:120]))
    return []
detail = [text] + [str(f.get("title")) + ": " + str(f.get("value")) for f in first.get("fields") or []
                   if isinstance(f, dict) and f.get("value")]
if first.get("title_link"):
    detail.append(str(first["title_link"]))
return [{"json": {"source": "semaphore", "host": ("Semaphore " + name)[:250], "service": "semaphore",
                  "state": state, "text": "\n".join(detail)}}]

parameters.pythonCode:
# One Databasus notification (the webhook's body: heading, message) as a ticket event: host,
# service, state, text. A ticket per database and kind (backup, health, verification, WAL);
# a success closes it. WAL alerts have no recovery: their tickets are closed by hand. Rules
# as zammad-bridge's databasus_to_checkmk (QUEUE-n8n-zammad.md).
import re

# A heading's kind, first match wins ("backup verification failed" is a verification;
# "Physical WAL gap" is WAL, not a backup).
KINDS = (("verification", re.compile(r"verification", re.IGNORECASE)),
         ("WAL", re.compile(r"\bWAL\b")),
         ("health", re.compile(r"\bDB is\b")),
         ("backup", re.compile(r"\bbackup\b|^Physical (FULL|INCR)\b", re.IGNORECASE)))
OK = re.compile(r"^✅|\b(completed|passed|is online)\b")

body = (_items[0]["json"].get("body") if _items else None) or {}
heading = str(body.get("heading") or "").strip() if isinstance(body, dict) else ""
if not heading:
    print("nothing to ticket: no heading")
    return []
if heading == "Test message":
    key, state = "test", "WARNING"
else:
    kind = next((k for k, pattern in KINDS if pattern.search(heading)), heading)
    named = re.search(r'"((?:[^"\\]|\\.)*)"', heading) or re.search(r"\[([^\]]+)\]", heading)
    key = kind + " " + named.group(1) if named and kind != heading else kind
    state = "OK" if OK.search(heading) else "CRITICAL"
message = str(body.get("message") or "").strip()
return [{"json": {"source": "databasus", "host": ("Databasus " + key)[:250], "service": "databasus",
                  "state": state, "text": "\n".join(x for x in (heading, message) if x)}}]
